messages:
Maya (Finance): Heads up — AWS invoice INV-2468-CCB-019 shows a backdated proration/adjustment for CloudBridge that doesn't match our seat ledger. There's a $3,540 credit line on SKU cb-seat-monthly-std. Can we triage?
Owen (RevOps): Can you paste the invoice lines or a screenshot? last month had that mid-cycle seat swap so could be a proration mismatch.
Priya (Billing): grabbing export now, attaching snippet:
```
invoice_id,sku,quantity,period_start,period_end,amount
INV-2468-CCB-019,cb-seat-monthly-std,12,2026-02-01,2026-02-28,3540.00
INV-2468-CCB-019,cb-seat-monthly-std,9,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,-3540.00
```
BillingBot: Detected potential duplicate adjustment for INV-2468-CCB-019 amount 3540. Flagged as requires-approval.
Carlos (Partner Ops): CloudBridge claims seats moved 2026-02-10 (12 -> 9). Partner portal shows 9 active for March. $3,540 seems like a full-month charge, not a 20-day proration. Could be duplicate or export bug.
Owen (RevOps): @Priya can you cross-check the marketplace UI meterlines vs our export? If it's a duplicate charge i'm fine with provisional credit but need confirmation. :+1:
Priya (Billing): Will do. Quick check: marketplace UI sometimes reports aggregated seat-months; need raw meterlines from AWS. I'll open a support case asking for raw meterline CSV for subscription SN-CCB-772.
Maya (Finance): Approve prepping a credit memo draft (CM-2468-CCB) but HOLD on issuing payment until we get AWS raw meterlines and partner confirmation. :eyes: Also confirm GL code — provisional use '6005-Marketplace-Rebates' and tag `acct-rcpts`.
Carlos (Partner Ops): I'll ping CloudBridge account rep and AWS partner support now. Message to partner: "Hi — can you confirm seat delta and provide portal screenshots for Feb/Mar?"
Priya (Billing): Filing internal ticket FIN-2026-1183 to track reconciliation and CM. ETA to draft CM and attach evidence: EOD today.
BillingBot: Ticket FIN-2026-1183 created by Priya (Billing). Status: open.
Owen (RevOps): @Maya I'm +1 on draft CM. If AWS confirms duplicate we can fast-track credit. Otherwise we may need to calculate prorated amount.
Maya (Finance): Agreed. If it's a true proration, compute using: seats_removed * seat_rate * (days_off / days_in_period). If discrepancy persists, escalate to ops for ledger correction.
Priya (Billing): Noted. I'll post updates here once AWS replies and after CloudBridge confirms.
Carlos (Partner Ops): Update: pinged both, timestamped request ID PR-8473 to partner rep. Will share replies.
Maya (Finance): Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source. Please add any attachments to FIN-2026-1183.
Priya (Billing): Roger.
Maya (Finance): closing interim, will unhold when AWS raw meterline CSV received. :white_check_mark:
